description: Itinéraires et boucles cyclables du Gard is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Gard. The Gard department maintains a repository of cycle loops and routes developed in its territory. This allows in particular to feed the Observatoire National des Véloroutes (ON3V) in connection with Vélo et Territoires. The structure of the database is a subset of geo-standard Véloroutes and Green Ways. Coverage: Département du Gard. The portal shows the English title as "Itineraries and cycle loops of the Gard" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Gard. Its keywords include velo, deplacement, cyclable, gard. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GPX, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
